maria (Docs): Quick: PR #6180 needs tiny edits for streaming snippets — add jittered retries, note resume-token TTL (24h), and a short fallback to polling pages. Who can update py/ts/go?

sam (SDK): I can own this. Keep examples short (<=8 lines) and add one-line about batch_size trade-off.

eli (PY SDK): Draft pushed to branch docs/stream-small. Python example uses jittered backoff + resume-token persist: ```py
from sdk import Retry
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=1.5)
for chunk in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
    if getattr(chunk, 'resume_token', None):
        save_resume(chunk.resume_token)
    print(chunk.text)
```

jon (Go eng): I'll add a tiny Go pattern emphasizing context cancel + reconnect hint: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for ch := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Println(ch.Text) }
// on error: perform exponential backoff with jitter then retry
```

linda (TS SDK): TS snippet added as async iterator; typed resumeToken as string|undefined. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) {
  if (p.resumeToken) storeResume(p.resumeToken)
  console.log(p.text)
}
```

maria (Docs): Two editorial asks: 1) add this exact line: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; callers should persist tokens if they plan to resume." 2) add a one-paragraph fallback: if resume fails, switch to polling pages. Include this minimal pseudocode block (no full app): ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
```
